parsed.corrected_rationale: The comment references the proposed method PROP-GRACE, which counts as a specific, identifiable element/unique aspect of the paper, though the authors may need an educated guess to locate the exact section describing it. It thus identifies the referenced part (the proposed method) but does not further detail which details are missing. This matches the rubric category where the addressed part is identifiable while the needed fix is clearly specified.
